name: Jinbe
description: Base-only Jinbe, a whale-shark fish-man with no Devil Fruit. Fish-Man Karate/Jujutsu drive direct-contact water force; Haki and Buraikan add combat utility. Helmsmanship is adapted as ally range support; navigation, Shark Network, defense and Uchimizu deflection are omitted. Numbers are gameplay tuning.

paths.name: Fish-Man Karate
paths.description: Extends Jinbe's no-contact water force, models strikes through water within the target, and improves his disciplined attack rhythm without invoking a Devil Fruit.

upgrades.name: Heavy Palm
upgrades.description: Adds the force expected from Jinbe's exceptional fish-man strength.

upgrades.name: Karate Mastery
upgrades.description: Improves the efficiency of Jinbe's refined Fish-Man Karate strikes.

upgrades.name: Water-Particle Reach
upgrades.description: Extends the air-water force beyond ordinary melee range without changing it into a projectile.

upgrades.name: Body-Water Shock
upgrades.description: Adds an internal damage fraction, adapting Jinbe's demonstrated ability to affect water within a target's body.

upgrades.name: Delayed Force
upgrades.description: Shortens primary timing as a gameplay adaptation of Jinbe's delayed, disciplined water-force release.

paths.name: Fish-Man Jujutsu
paths.description: Models liquid-as-cloth manipulation, forceful weight redirection and tactical grappling. Uchimizu's defensive deflection is not separately simulated, and no independent water creation is claimed.

upgrades.name: Liquid Cloth Grip
upgrades.description: Extends Jinbe's effective reach through Fish-Man Jujutsu's tangible-liquid manipulation.

upgrades.name: Redirected Weight
upgrades.description: Improves damage as an adaptation of Jinbe's advanced grappling and weight-redirection throws.

upgrades.name: Binding Throw
upgrades.description: Adds impact force to close grapples and throws, useful against large or durable targets.

upgrades.name: Current Reading
upgrades.description: Enables primary retargeting when the selected target is lost before resolution, useful against evasive formations.

upgrades.name: Long-Current Control
upgrades.description: Further extends modeled liquid manipulation at range; this is a gameplay adaptation, not independent water creation.

paths.name: Knight of the Sea
paths.description: Combines Jinbe's physical power with Armament and Observation Haki, ending in a Buraikan-inspired piercing shockwave. Kairagi's defensive combat is omitted because it is unsupported by this runtime.

upgrades.name: Whale-Shark Power
upgrades.description: Adds another flat damage increase for Jinbe's tremendous physical strength.

upgrades.name: Armament Haki
upgrades.description: Adds authored armor penetration to Jinbe's hardened Fish-Man Karate and Jujutsu blows.

upgrades.name: Observation Haki
upgrades.description: Allows the unit to detect concealed eligible targets, adapting Jinbe's presence-sensing ability.

upgrades.name: Veteran's Read
upgrades.description: Enables primary retargeting when a target is lost before resolution, adapting Jinbe's tactical battlefield judgment.

upgrades.name: Buraikan
upgrades.description: Adds a periodic piercing water shockwave from the contact point; it can exceed primary reach, stops at obstacles and triggers no other effects.
